capabilities: Paste the clipboard image binary into the note via a command
Fetch and paste images from image URLs found in HTML rich text or plain-text clipboard items
Optionally intercept paste events so binary pasting becomes the default behavior
Optionally keep the source URL as a markdown link alongside the image
Provide a mobile ribbon button for one-click binary paste
extras: Warns that hooking the paste-event interceptor on every paste may interfere with other plugins that also use the paste event; MIT licensed and PRs are welcome.
motivation: The author found it frustrating that copied images often paste as URLs and that Obsidian is more idiosyncratic about it than other applications.
problem: Pasting after 'Copy Image' often inserts the image's URL as text instead of the image, and which format wins varies unpredictably across applications, websites, and Obsidian's clipboard handling.
summary: Clipboard-aware image paste tool that inserts the actual image binary or downloads image URLs instead of pasting the URL text.
